CheckTitle: CTS tracker has LTS log transfer enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Trace Service (CTS)** trackers transfer audit traces to **Log Tank Service (LTS)** for real-time log search, alerting, and correlation.
Risk: Without **LTS integration**, security teams cannot perform real-time alerting or fast log querying on CTS management events, delaying detection of unauthorized API activity.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Cloud Trace Service (CTS)** > **Tracker List**.
3. Click **Configure** on the target tracker.
4. Enable **Transfer to LTS**.
5. Click **OK**.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **LTS log transfer** on CTS trackers to support real-time security monitoring and alerting.
